summary: Elemental Royalty Corp filed a Form 6-K announcing the publication of its 2026 Royalty Asset Handbook, the launch of a new corporate website, and its participation in a virtual non-deal roadshow. The filing contains no transaction, no change in control, and no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or capital return. It is an ordinary investor relations update with no deal terms, board actions, or structural changes. Accordingly, this is classified as a routine current report with no special-situation relevance.
